name: searchmaster
description: Compare brand visibility in AI search and research competitor domains and keywords.

interface.longDescription: SearchMaster helps marketers compare a brand with its competitors across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and Perplexity. Find competitor domains and ranked keywords, or draft an llms.txt file. Results depend on available data. Anonymous use is subject to trial limits. Compatible clients can use a SearchMaster personal key.
defaultPrompt: Where does Notion rank against its competitors in AI search?
Which keywords does stripe.com rank for?
